# What training installs

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-training-installs` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](what-training-installs.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Training read as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates installs a law only along its own courses and as far as the learner's representation lumps them, through a reward only where its couplings separate, and among settled laws by the search's start and neighbourhoods.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A law is fixed by what it does along its own course: two laws of what has stood that exchange alike along the levels the first generates generate the same levels, with no premise of feasibility. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.AlongAlike`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.exchange_along`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.levels_agree_of_along`)
2. Training read as a selection over a learner's candidate act laws through the courses each generates, a situation fixing the others' law (a realization of their noise), the start and the execution: two candidates giving alike, for the part, along the course the first generates in each situation have the same courses, and every training reading candidates through their courses trains them alike. (`Becoming.Training.levels`, `Becoming.Training.course`, `Becoming.Training.SameCourses`, `Becoming.Training.Reads`, `Becoming.Training.same_courses_of_along`, `Becoming.Training.trained_alike_of_along`)
3. Exploration: a law explored on a schedule acts by an exploring law at the steps the schedule marks; two laws giving alike at the steps left to them along the explored courses have the same explored courses, so what the law does at an exploring step, or under a history no explored course passes, is installed by no training. (`Becoming.Training.explore`, `Becoming.Training.explore_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.Training.explored_same_courses`)
4. Off its courses, within the laws reading through a lumping of histories (a representation; the part's coupling and agreement itself are lumpings): two with the same courses take and give alike at every history the lumping lumps with one of the courses. (`Becoming.Training.Lumping`, `Becoming.Training.agree_symm`, `Becoming.Training.alike_of_agree`, `Becoming.Training.Lumping.coupling`, `Becoming.Training.Lumping.agreement`, `Becoming.Training.ReadsThrough`, `Becoming.Training.ReadsThrough.of_through`, `Becoming.Training.ReadsThrough.through`, `Becoming.Training.ReadsThrough.of_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.Training.installed_where_lumped`, `Becoming.Training.installed_where_alike`)
5. At a history the lumping lumps with no course (decided), for every amount some law reading what has stood and through the lumping, with the same courses, takes it there; given a history the lumping separates from it, some such law takes alike under the two and some differently. The coupling and agreement are cases: nothing is installed off the courses beyond what the representation lumps with them. (`Becoming.Training.setOn`, `Becoming.Training.setOn_take_off`, `Becoming.Training.setOn_take_at`, `Becoming.Training.setOn_respects`, `Becoming.Training.setOn_lumped`, `Becoming.Training.free_where_unlumped`, `Becoming.Training.response_free_where_unlumped`, `Becoming.Training.response_free_where_apart`, `Becoming.Training.response_free_off_courses`)
6. A training through a selector r's couplings up to T selects alike candidates whose levels are alike through them in every situation; every such training reads the courses, and two candidates are trained alike by every one exactly when their levels are alike through r's couplings in every situation (by construction, as Web.selects_alike_iff). (`Becoming.Training.TrainsThrough`, `Becoming.Training.TrainsThrough.reads`, `Becoming.Training.trained_alike_iff`)
7. What a reward through r's couplings settles on, its optimum among the candidates, is such a training; a score of level histories through them read in one situation is such a reward; and with the class decided, where two candidates' levels are apart through r's couplings in one situation some such reward settles on the first and not on the second. (`Becoming.Training.RewardsThrough`, `Becoming.Training.Settles`, `Becoming.Training.settles_through`, `Becoming.Training.score_rewards`, `Becoming.Training.settles_apart`)
8. A search step improving for a reward stays or moves to a candidate rewarded more; every candidate the reward settles on is a rest of every improving search, which started there stays; under a reward at most B it rests from every start by step B + 1, so the basin of a start is its orbit there. (`Becoming.Training.Improving`, `Becoming.Training.settled_rests`, `Becoming.Training.settled_stays`, `Becoming.Training.rested_or_risen`, `Becoming.Training.comes_to_rest`)
9. A local search over a neighbourhood relation, its parameterization, rests exactly where no neighbour is rewarded more, and with every candidate a neighbour exactly where the reward settles: the rests a narrower neighbourhood adds are its implicit bias. (`Becoming.Training.LocalSearch`, `Becoming.Training.LocalSearch.improving`, `Becoming.Training.LocalSearch.rests_iff`, `Becoming.Training.LocalSearch.rests_iff_settles`)
10. With the situations' laws reading what has stood and through coupling, both candidates reading what has stood, the first through its members' coupling, and both courses feasible in every situation, two candidates agreeing on every condition coupled into r's coupling closure, drawn through their two courses, are trained alike by every training through r's couplings. (`Becoming.Training.trained_alike_beyond_closure`)
11. A reading the same for every candidate leaves the optimum at any weight: a reward adding it settles exactly where the reward without it settles. Where in every candidate's course renewal is gated at need one and the rest takes jointly more than is given at each of n steps from T, from a level at most n, every score reading the condition only from T + n on is such a reading. (`Becoming.Training.settles_weighted_iff`, `Becoming.Training.outrun_reading_same`, `Becoming.Training.outrun_settles_iff`)
12. A computed commons: the learner's reward reads its store and the stock at step four through its coupling, by level, into both. Where the rest draws within the renewal, restraint is settled exactly at weights of at least one; where it outruns the renewal, restraint is settled at no weight and the drawing law at every weight. (`Becoming.Training.Commons.Member`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.present`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.others`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.drawing`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.restraint`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.cand`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.part`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.start`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.lev`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.reward`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.obs`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.web`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.reward_through`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.couples_into_stock`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.renewed_restraint_reward`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.renewed_drawing_reward`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.outrun_restraint_reward`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.outrun_drawing_reward`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.one_le_of_le`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.renewed_restraint_settles_iff`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.outrun_restraint_unsettled`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.outrun_drawing_settles`)
13. In the same commons at weight one, with the rest within the renewal, both laws are settled, the drawing law responding to the stock and restraint not, and every improving search keeps the one it starts from; where the rest outruns it, a search with empty neighbourhoods rests at restraint, which no weight settles on, and one with every candidate a neighbour leaves it. (`Becoming.Training.Commons.renewed_both_settle`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.drawing_responds`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.start_decides`, `Becoming.Training.Commons.outrun_neighbourhood_decides`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The situations' laws and the candidates read what has stood wherever the on-course, exploration and off-course laws enter; for the off-course laws, the law reading through a lumping and being lumped with the history decided; for the closure law, the situations' laws reading through coupling and both courses feasible; for the outrun laws, outrun_below's premises in every candidate's course; for the basin law, a bound on the reward. A training reads each candidate through its own courses, as the optimum of any reward does.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which lumping an actual architecture's representation makes, or which neighbourhoods its updates search: the laws say what any lumping installs and where any neighbourhood rests, not which a given system has, which is read empirically.
- The weights a training gives noise realizations or explored courses: they change which candidate is rewarded more, not what a training can install; and which basin a particular start lies in, beyond that it is reached within the bound.
- The evidence that an actual system was trained this way.
- That a learner ought to respond to what it couples into, or that restraint is better: the laws say what a training can install, not what it should.
- **Counterexample:** Training.Commons: the learner's reward couples into the stock by level and reads it at step four, yet where the rest draws two a step against a renewal of one, restraint is settled at no weight and the drawing law at every weight (outrun_restraint_unsettled, outrun_drawing_settles): coupling into a condition does not install a response to it. With the rest drawing one, the same reward settles on restraint from weight one (renewed_restraint_settles_iff). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Training.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Chapter section 7.7 left open how training installs a law that responds to what it couples into, and section 8.1 item 7 how a member's law forms; CG2's X2 found that weighting the end reading sixteen times more changed nothing. The on-course law is the on-policy point of imitation learning (Ross, Gordon and Bagnell 2011) and the formal kernel of goal misgeneralization (Langosco, Koch, Sharkey, Pfau and Krueger 2022; Shah et al. 2022); the outrun law is pivotality (Palfrey and Rosenthal 1984) read on a reward; among settled laws stochastic stability (Kandori, Mailath and Rob 1993; Young 1993) is one rule selecting a basin, by noise, cited. Reading (the AI's, with the scope of chapter section 7, D45): training reaches only along the learner's own courses, as far as its representation lumps them, and only through what the reward couples into; where the reading falls against what the rest does decides, not its weight, and among equally rewarded laws the search's start decides.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [counterfactual-is-the-course](counterfactual-is-the-course.md). Reuses ExchangeLaw, Nonanticipating, withAct, levels, course, history_agree, levels_succ, Feasible and withAct_nonanticipating; the delta fixes a law's generated levels by what it does along them, with no premise of feasibility (course_unique gives this for a feasible course).
  - Output: The course a law of exchange generates from the starting levels.
  - Input: A learner's courses, one per candidate act law and situation, and their fixing by what the candidate does along them.
  - Preserved conditions: Laws reading what has stood; discrete steps, whole-number amounts. [Counterfactual.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counterfactual.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [selection-through-couplings](selection-through-couplings.md). Reuses Web.SelectsThrough, Web.ScoresThrough, Web.AlikeThroughUpTo, Web.class_selects and the structure of Web.selects_alike_iff; the delta reads a selection over candidates through the levels their courses generate.
  - Output: A selection through a formation's couplings reaches exactly what couples into it.
  - Input: A training through a reward's couplings on the learner's own courses.
  - Preserved conditions: That a given training goes through those couplings is supplied. [Selection.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [the-gap-for-ones-own-act](the-gap-for-ones-own-act.md). Reuses act_courses_unselected: with both acts laws, a selection through the coupling of a formation within the closure selects the two courses alike; the delta reads it with the reward as that formation and the training as the selection.
  - Output: The gap for one's own act, with nothing supplied.
  - Input: Candidates agreeing on what couples into the reward's closure are trained alike.
  - Preserved conditions: The rest's law reads what has stood and through coupling; the candidates read what has stood, the first through its members' coupling; both courses feasible. [SelectionGap.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SelectionGap.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [the-rest-outruns-the-renewal](the-rest-outruns-the-renewal.md). Reuses Flow.outrun_reading_alike on every candidate's course; the delta adds that a reading the same for every candidate moves no optimum at any weight.
  - Output: Every reading after the rest's end is alike under a member's acts.
  - Input: A reward adding such a reading settles where the reward without it settles.
  - Preserved conditions: Balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, renewal gated at need one, the rest outrunning from a level at most n, in every candidate's course. [Exclusion.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Exclusion.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). Training.fit_right_iff and Training.unselected_beyond_data hold for data fixed in advance; here the data are the courses the candidate itself generates, and the same boundary falls on them.
- related, not a proved adapter: [what-a-pools-acts-respond-to](what-a-pools-acts-respond-to.md). Coupling bounds response and does not fix it (ExchangeLaw.response_not_fixed_by_coupling); here what a training through a reward can fix within that bound.
